retrieved.title: 《寂静的朋友》影像风格提示词 · 视频提示词 1
资料退化：磁带与扫描线

request:
镜头 s26：纪录片细节特写镜头，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary insert close-up grabbed handheld, focus breathing
导演意图（自然语言）：特写，固定，资料影像质感。一只只手把实体钥匙卡一张接一张放进红色镜头下的钢托盘里，托盘越堆越满。环境声：卡片落进托盘的清脆声、大厅的回声。
情绪：ceremonial, cold, irreversible
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off archival camera
景深与虚实：Archival softness; the cards in focus, the red lens a blurred glow above.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival close-up in the handover hall: gloved and bare hands lay plain physical access key cards one after another into a steel tray beneath the glowing red lens; the tray is filling up. The cards are blank, no text. Blocking lock: the steel tray sits at frame lower centre, hands enter from left and right, the red lens glows soft at the top of frame.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
Picture 3: the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority (location reference; role: location reference). A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：crisp clatter of cards on steel, hall echo
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/cam-insert] 机位：细节特写插入
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[rules/size/insert-shot] size

画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

attempts.output:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the storyboard keyframe of this shot, an archival close-up in the 2058 handover hall from <Picture 1>, serving as composition, lighting and blocking reference. The opening frame is a tight view down onto a brushed-steel tray that sits at frame lower centre, its rim scuffed and dull, already part-filled with a fan of blank plain physical access key cards, no text, no numbers, no magnetic stripe lettering. Gloved and bare hands enter the frame from left and right, a card pinched between finger and thumb, a dark sleeve cuff at frame left, a bare wrist at frame right. Above the tray, filling the top of the frame, the round red lens of the terminal glows soft and out of focus, spilling a dull red wash over the steel and the pale card edges; the rest of the hall falls away into cold white murk. Palette: cold white, steel grey, dull red. Blocking lock: steel tray lower centre, hands entering from frame left and frame right, red lens a soft glow at the top of frame, hall dissolving into the background.
<Subject 2> is the MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) from <Picture 2>, serving as the central AI's physical presence. An artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red at its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people moving in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings. In this shot only the glowing lens and the thin red ring sit above the tray, soft and out of focus.
<Subject 3> is the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority from <Picture 3>, serving as location reference. A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people. In this shot only its cold white light, its red wash and its long echo are present.

summary:
In the 2058 handover hall, an archival close-up looks down onto a steel tray as gloved and bare hands lay blank physical access key cards into it one after another, the pile rising under the soft red glow of the terminal lens. No one speaks; the clip ends on the last card dropped flat onto the heap, the hall in cold white light. Final frame: the full tray at frame lower centre, the red lens a blurred glow at the top of frame.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 2> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — black glass housing, single round deep-red lens and thin red ring retained; only its scale in frame changes as a soft glow.
<Subject 3> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — hall environment, cold white light and red reflection retained as the location.

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off archival camera on the hall floor, frame held steady through the whole take, no move, only the faintest gate weave and a single rolling noise bar at the frame edge; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the steel tray at frame lower centre, hands entering from frame left and frame right, the red lens a soft glow at the top of frame, the cold white hall dissolved behind. Start: a bare hand from frame right tips a blank access key card over the tray rim, the card catching the red wash along its edge. Middle: hand after hand arrives from left and right, cards dropping one on another with a small hard clatter, the operator's grip each time releasing at the same instant, the heap rising until the last card skids a little on the ones beneath and settles flat; the red glow pulses faintly once across the steel. End: the hands withdraw out of frame left and right, the tray sits full and still, the top card rocking once and stopping. Mood: ceremonial, cold, irreversible. Blur: archival softness across the whole frame; the cards and the tray rim sharp, the red lens a blurred glow above, the hall fully dissolved into cold white murk. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Crisp clatter of stiff cards landing on steel, a thin skid as the last card settles, the long cold echo of the hall, faint cloth rustle of sleeves, one unsteady breath near the microphone, low electrical hum of the terminal, tape hiss; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
